name: cruise
description: mock cruise travel agent application to demonstrate coding ability
author: Jay Gallagher

scripts.start: npm run react:build && docker compose up -d && SUPPRESS_DB_LOGS=true DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:password@127.0.0.1:5433/cruise node --watch index.js
scripts.integrationTests: npm run db:test:ready && NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1 jest --config jest.integration.config.js --runInBand --detectOpenHandles
scripts.test: npm run jest:coverage:all && npm run uiTests:react
scripts.test:all: npm run test:inventory:audit && npm run react:production:complete && npm run jest:coverage:all && npm run browserTests:react && npm run perf:smoke:local && npm run lighthouse:ci:local
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.lighthouse:ci:local: npm run react:build && start-server-and-test start http://localhost:8000/health lighthouse:ci
scripts.lighthouse:ci:ci: npm run react:build && start-server-and-test start:ci http://localhost:8000/health lighthouse:ci
scripts.playwright:mobile:ci: npm run react:build && start-server-and-test start:ci http://localhost:8000 "playwright test --config=playwright.mobile.config.js playwright/mobile/react-app-next-mobile.spec.js"
scripts.playwright:responsive:ci: npm run react:build && start-server-and-test start:ci http://localhost:8000 "playwright test --config=playwright.responsive.config.js playwright/responsive/react-app-next-responsive.spec.js"
scripts.portfolio:audit: npm run repo:hygiene && npm run test:all
scripts.uiTests:react: npm run react:build && start-server-and-test start http://localhost:8000 cypress:run:react
scripts.playwright:mobile:react: npm run react:build && start-server-and-test start http://localhost:8000 "playwright test --config=playwright.mobile.config.js playwright/mobile/react-app-next-mobile.spec.js"
scripts.playwright:responsive:react: npm run react:build && start-server-and-test start http://localhost:8000 "playwright test --config=playwright.responsive.config.js playwright/responsive/react-app-next-responsive.spec.js"
scripts.browserTests:react: npm run uiTests:react && npm run playwright:mobile:react && npm run playwright:responsive:react
scripts.test:react:all: npm run jest:coverage:all && npm run browserTests:react
scripts.react:production:audit: npm run react:readiness:audit && npm run react:production:complete && npm run browserTests:react
scripts.uiTests:react:ci: npm run react:build && start-server-and-test start:ci http://localhost:8000 cypress:run:react
